reason: I'd probably grab the free week, but honestly I already do free postpartum stuff on YouTube when the kids let me, and I've never stuck with anything I've paid for. Twenty bucks isn't much, but I'd likely drift off after the free sessions before ever paying.
objection: There are free postpartum workouts on YouTube, so I'm not sure what I'd get for the money that I can't already find, and I doubt I'd actually find the time four days a week.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of mums from my mums' group doing it together and saying the physio-checked tummy gap stuff actually helped them.
